Name: Briar Deva
Information:
**Briar Deva**

A briar deva is an extension of Aymere, who assume a humanoid form wrapped in wooden bindings and ametrine mineral horns, ornately adorned. They rarely leave the Whisperwood, and exist mostly to tend to and care for the most fragile bastions of nature to exist. They speak to archdruids and great beasts, guiding them to care for the world around them, rarely stepping in to combat the forces of evil unless needed. Their most common battles are against yokai and fiends who corrupt nature directly.

traits.name: Barkskinned
traits.description: The deva’s AC is calculated as 16 + its Dexterity modifier.

traits.name: Divine Judgement
traits.description: When speaking with a mortal creature, the deva can divine the crimes committed during their life and the context surrounding them, which the deva knows with great familiarity.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: The deva’s spellcasting ability is Wisdom. It can cast the following spells, requiring no components. The deva counts as a druid for the purposes of considerations for spell effects.

traits.name: Wise Attacks
traits.description: The deva uses Wisdom for its attack and damage rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The deva makes two Twisting Limb attacks.

actions.name: Twisting Limbs
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage. If this attack hits a target who is Huge or smaller, the deva can give up its next attack through Multiattack this turn to entangle the target in twisting roots and bark, causing them to be restrained. The creature can make a DC 18 Athletics check against this effect in place of a weapon attack (as though grappling), ending the effect on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: The deva magically polymorphs into a humanoid of any description, a beast of a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back to its true form. If it dies it reverts to its true form. In any humanoid form its statistics remain the same, but in the form of a beast it assumes the AC, movement speed(s), Strength, Dexterity, senses, attacks, and actions of that beast (except class features, Legendary Actions and Lair Actions), but retains access to its own actions and senses as well.

bonus_actions.name: Tree Step
bonus_actions.description: The deva teleports to the space of any Large or larger tree within 60 feet, and emerges in an unoccupied space adjacent to it.
